description: Defines a singleton class HeartbeatStore that observes heartbeat events via NotificationCenter, decodes incoming data into ControlHeartbeatEvent, and maintains the latest event. It uses Swift Concurrency with async/await and is integrated with SwiftUI's concurrency model.

classes.name: HeartbeatStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for observing heartbeat notifications, decoding the events, and providing access to the latest Heartbeat event.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the HeartbeatStore, setting up notification observation and fetching the last heartbeat if needed.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the notification observer when the instance is deallocated.
